newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RUGBY UNION-BURKE AND MANU RULED OUT AGAINST FRANC.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BURKE AND MANU RULED OUT AGAINST FRANC.

text.p: Australia were dealt a double blow on Tuesday when injuries ruled out full-back Matt Burke and number eight Daniel Manu from the second rugby union test against France.
Wallaby coach Greg Smith promoted full-back Stephen Larkham and veteran back-rower Troy Coker to face the French at Ballymore on Saturday in the final test of the series.
Burke broke down in training with a recurrence of the groin injury that forced him to miss Australia's 29-15 defeat of the Five Nations champions in Sydney on Saturday.

Manu failed a fitness test on a shoulder injury but could yet be named as a reserve if he improves sufficiently before Saturday, the Australian Rugby Union said in a statement announcing the team changes.

Burke's withdrawal was expected to give winger Mitch Hardy another chance to impress. Hardy scored the two tries that broke a 15-15 deadlock in the first test during a brief stint as a temporary replacement while Larkham underwent treatment for a facial injury.

Australia: 15-Stephen Larkham; 14-Ben Tune, 13-Jason Little, 12-Pat Howard, 11-Joe Roff; 10-Tim Horan, 9-George Gregan; 8-Troy Coker, 7-David Wilson, 6-Brett Robinson, 5-John Eales (captain), 4-David Giffin, 3-Ewen McKenzie, 2-Marco Caputo, 1-Richard Harry.
